AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
https://ag-ui.com

 
 

 
 
The open protocol that connects any agent to any app.
 
 
    
 
 
Docs · Examples · Spec · Discord
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.

items.title: Show HN: An ASCII cell aquarium for your terminal
items.contentSnippet:
I made a virtual microscope slide for your terminal (inspired by asciiquarium and cbonsai). Cells divide, immune cells chase bacteria, and bacteriophages occasionally cause trouble.  You can try it with:
$ pipx install terminal-cells
$ cells
I'd appreciate any suggestions for additional animations to add, especially entities or events that would be visually distinct given the graphical limitations. Any cell biologists in the house?

items.contentSnippet:
I built mdkit, a menu bar app for storing and sharing skill markdown files.
Just drop your .md files into mdkit to store them in the cloud, then drag them out whenever you need them.
Share files by email with viewer or editor permissions. Every save is versioned.
Why I built it: 
I wanted a simple, AI-platform-independent way to share and manage AI skills across teams, with features like editing permissions and version history.

items.contentSnippet:

You use headers and paragraphs, tables or highlighted text to create flashcards and cloze deletions, which you can then review using FSRS algorithm. Everything stays local, it uses a SQL lite db internally to keep track of state and keep the markdown document clean.
